data_basis: generic assumed values for a public worked configuration; no project data

diagnostic_serialization.basis: nearest resolution for diagnostic differences, closure values/margins and shape coordinates; statuses use unrounded values
diagnostic_serialization.closure_envelope_tie_rule: smallest closure margin at diagnostic resolution; violations precede passes on a tie, then declared offset order

sensitivity_basis: generic nominal wall steps (assumed), not a vendor catalogue
sensitivity_metrics: rank-1 candidate envelope over all offsets: maximum top tension/utilisation, minimum radius; percentages use six-significant-figure metric values

stress_comparator_evidence.basis: numerical-noise agreement across all base offsets and wall-step runs; no sampling allowance
stress_comparator_evidence.maximum_difference_tie_rule: first row in declared case, wall-step and offset order after diagnostic quantisation
